t: Collect 4 Bear Heads, tie them together with the Reinforced Rope, and place it in the goblins' camp. If the shaman shows up - defeat him. Return to Denis Molotov when you are done.

You're probably aware by now that the goblins have captured our salt mine. They haven't made any demands as yet, but I have no intention of negotiating with them anyway. We've got to nail them to the wall so they know who the boss is around here. Anything else would be a waste of time. We'll do something else.
So listen. They worship bears. Laughable, isn't it? So you kill four bears, chop off their heads, and string them up with a rope. Then you place the heads on the totem pole in the goblins' camp. Let them enjoy the view!
I bet this sacrilege will make them nervous. Maybe even their shaman pops up. If that happens - good. Defeat him! Let them see what's what. And search the body. Maybe you'll find something useful.
Almost all of them are at the salt lake now, so it shouldn't be very difficult to get into their camp. Their village is in Southern Riverside, across from the lake and the bears are in the woods northwest from here.
How's it going with the bears? Stop dragging your feet, the goblins must be taught a lesson!

There was a Bear Tribe Orc in the camp? And a shaman to boot! What could he be doing there, I wonder? Could he have come for the salt? Never mind, that doesn't matter now. It's a good thing that he's dead.
We tried trading with the goblins and Orcs recently, but nothing came of it. It's easier to trade with the squirrels in the woods than with those primitives! Here's a small present for your excellent service. Thank you.
Show Ermolai's Helmet to Vlad Strezhnev.

This is an interesting helm... There is an ornate symbol on the back, possibly the sign of the blacksmith who made it. This magnificent piece must have been commissioned for a great hero. This helm should be shown to Vlad Strezhnev.

Damnit, this is Ermolai's helmet! He was wearing it when he left on his journey. I still remember seeing him march off to the east in the light of the morning sun...
I want to know how that beast got this helmet. I hope that damned Orc didn't kill Ermolai. Maybe he just lost the helmet while he was crossing the river, or maybe it was stolen from him? Let's remain calm and hope for the best!
Destroy 3 Waterfolk Boats and kill 4 Waterfolk Boatmen. Report back to Yefim Molotov in Gravestein.

As I've already told you, these waterfolk are interfering with free trade. They won't obey our laws - they just keep living according to their primitive principles.
We can't chase them out of the Vertush, but if we destroy their boats, then things will hopefully become quiet on the river, at least for a short amount of time. But don't imagine even for a minute that this will be a simple matter, the waterfolk rarely leave their belongings without supervision.
The waterfolk better be without boats. Why else would you come back?

Your clothes are filthy, I see the raid was successful. Well done!
Now we don't have to worry about pirates - of course, they won't waste any time building new boats, but by then we'll have thought of something else.

Kill the Waterfolk chief and 4 Marauders or Sorcerers.

Obtain the cuirass and take it to the elders of Gravestein.

The Waterfolk have recently attacked Gravestein, which is surprising seeing as Ermolai had an arrangement with them! Hm...
We recently noticed a Kanian shield on their leader. It's an exact copy of the one Ermolai wore when he stopped by here.
At first we assumed we'd got it wrong - surely there were lots of similar shields around! But if an Orc had Ermolai's helmet, then it's entirely possible for one of the Waterfolk to have his shield.
There's only one way to be sure - we have to check the maker's stamp. If it was forged by the same blacksmith as the helm, then it really is a piece of Ermolai's armor.
You'll have to meet with the Waterfolk's leader, but we doubt he'll give you the shield willingly. Kill four of his tribesmen while you're at it so they won't dream of making a return visit.
Bring the shield to us as soon as you find it! I'm curious!
Where's the breastplate? Or don't you care about Ermolai's fate anymore?
This is exactly what we were afraid of. See for yourself - it has the same mark as the helm. This is a bad sign, but let's not bury Ermolai just yet. Maybe there's another explanation for this...
Escort Ignat Zhdanov to the boat and notify the Somber Family.

I don't know how to thank you for finding me! The waterfolk ambushed me on the shore - they were probably going to eat me or use me as a human sacrifice, or maybe sacrifice me first and eat me later!
My boat is hidden under the dock but I'm afraid to go there by myself. Please do me a favor and help me to get out of here. I'll give you a reward for helping. Just show this letter to Yefim Molotov. I'm sure he'll pay you more handsomely than I ever could!
I'm definitely quitting the courier business after this. My skin is more important to me. Screw the benefits and the bonuses!
Oh, what the heck?! The waterfolk captured a courier? Now I'll have to outfit the troops and attack the waterfolk camp. ...Oh, it's already done? Wow, I wish it were always like this!
Lost, huh... Fine, I got a couple spares. Here. Don't lose them!
Take the letter to Yefim Molotov.
This letter needs to be taken to Yefim Molotov in Gravestein. The merchant will probably pay a lot of money for it.
I heard that you rescued a courier of ours from the waterfolk? How did you do?

They say the waterfolk have lost their leader thanks to you. I approve! Maybe now they'll leave the area altogether, they have no business here. Oh, you say you have a letter for me? Okay, let me see it.
Kill 3 Waterfolk Wizards and report back to Yefim Molotov.

This is what we need to do about our river pirates.
They are led by three waterfolk wizards, who hide on a cliff high above a bend in the Vertush River. They can see everything from that height and that's how they know when to send their hooligans in to attack our river caravans. We must put a stop to this!
Go to the island in the bend in the river and find a path that leads up to the top of the cliff. And then get in there and turn those wizards into fish food!
Well, is the river road free now?
Excellent! What a bad habit, attacking caravans! I'm glad we could put a stop to this.
Use the Demonologist's Amulet on 3 Guardian Statues and notify the Somber Family in Gravestein.

I haven't seen you around Gravestein before. It's beautiful here, isn't it? But there're just too many undead - they're all coming from the ancient burial mounds nearby. But luckily, I can scare the dead away with magic.
Take my charm and renew the spells that I've placed on the protective statues around the village - otherwise those nasty skeletons will start rattling their bones around here again.
When you're done, report to the Somber Family in the village. I'm sure everyone here will be grateful.
We see you have one of the Elf's amulets. Did you manage to renew the spells around the city?
Good job. Those undead just won't let us be! We even had to organize a militia with us as its commander. But there are just too few people here to fight...
Drive the pegs into the ground to the south of Gravestein and return to the Cautious Family.

Siveria is full of gold. It's especially abundant here in the east, near the burial mounds. But ever since the Molotovs caught wind of it, they've been out here every day just trying to get their grubby hands on our land.
The title to this land was given to us Gibberlings by Ermolai himself. No one knows where he is now, so there isn't anyone to stand up for us!
There are lots of undead out there and no one has managed to stake their claims yet. If you can get out there and set our pegs up, we'll reward you handsomely!
You can't set the pegs just anywhere, though. They have to be where the gold is peeking through the surface. We saw four places - you can't miss them!
What, did the skeletons bite you?
Were there a lot of undead? I guess I'd be unhappy too if someone took my land. But they're dead! They're supposed to just lay there and stay dead!
Bring Corpse Fluid to the Eyepopping family.

We've got it, we know how to test you! As you may have noticed, we're up to our ears in the undead. What a pain! We've even organized a militia to destroy them. We brought in a necromancer and everything. Someday, we'll be able to get rid of the undead menace once and for all.
However, until that happens we need to make the most of the situation. You see, we've been having terrible back pains lately. We barely managed to get out of bed yesterday.
Now, do you know what the best remedy for back pain is? It's corpse fluid! The Gibberlings know how to make a powerful salve from corpse fluid that will cure anyone right away!
The bad news is that this fluid is very rare, but the good news is that there are lots of undead around here. So, hop to it! Kill every single undead that you see until you find a nice batch of corpse fluid for us!
What was that?! Speak up. Did you find the ichor?
Excellent! Now we need to steep it in alcohol, add some fat, and then we'll have the best back pain remedy in the whole world! Then we'll keep our promise and tell you about our sons.
Raise from the graves and kill 4 Zombie Warriors or Zombie Mages. Report to the Somber Family in Gravestein.

Oh, you want to help? Hm, okay, there's more than enough to do. I'm sure you've noticed the ancient tombs across the river. The undead have been coming out of them in droves lately. This problem can be dealt with, but only if we're fast enough.
You see, the undead must be destroyed while they're still in their graves. Then they're still relatively weak and defenseless. They're much more difficult to kill later, once they've regained their strength! If you want to help, go kill as many of the newly risen undead as possible.
Oh, when will this all be over?! It's so stressful living next to a horde of undead!
Hm... not bad, not bad at all. Defeating zombies isn't a piece of cake, even when they've just risen from their graves. Thank you for your help!
Find 3 Zem Tablets in the crypts for Christine de Desire.

The House de Desire has long been famous for its knowledge of necromancy. It was this art in particular that won the last Great Ball and brought our house into power. Necromancy has become very fashionable since then and Elves from other Houses have also begun studying it. Some have even made great progress, such as my teacher Alfred de Delice.
But we've since had a falling out. Our views as to the origins of the local undead differed. Alfred believes that they are nothing but remnants of some ancient necromancer's experiments. But that's not so!
I am positive that we are dealing with intelligent undead, undead from the tribe of Zem! You can see their tombs from here or if you look at those ancient giants! Could your regular, dumb undead have ever created things like that?!
Help me prove to him that I'm right. Go to the crypts of the undead on the bank of the Vertush and find clay tablets of the Zem tribe. These tablets are a sure sign that we are dealing with the Arisen.
Did you manage to find the clay tablets? I'm certain that they're in those crypts.
Wonderful! This is all I need to prove that Alfred was wrong! There's a reason that necromancy is the path of our House and none other - the House de Desirae!
Kill 4 Snowy Tigers or Taiga Tigers and their leader Nevian. Report back to the Cautious Family in Gravestein.

To be honest, I wasn't expecting you to fight off the undead with such ease. Many have tried to set up landmarks over there to no avail!
But I'd like to ask another favor of you now. We're being pestered by tigers - there are too many of them here and they're starting to get bold! They've started attacking people and even us poor Gibberlings! And once an animal tastes our delicious blood, there is no stopping them! We're just too tasty!
We're too afraid to set foot on the other side of the river. So you'll have to help us handle them! Kill four of them, but most importantly, kill their leader, Nevian. It  was the first of the tigers to taste the blood. It deserves to die first!
We'll be telling stories about you to our grandchildren!
The monster is dead? Your fearlessness is worthy of a ballad. Unfortunately, I am not much of a poet, and I don't have time for such silly nonsense.
Capture 3 Taiga Owl Ghosts using the Soulsucker for the Eyepopping family in Gravestein.

We can see that you're to be trusted. So listen up.
The Eyepopping family kept quiet and were extremely grumpy when they arrived here. We didn't need them to say anything - it was clear as day that their trip didn't go as planned. One day, we heard the three of them arguing. Frank said, "We've got to tell them everything!" Asgerd and Sam said, "We've got to keep quiet!" But we don't know what it is they're keeping quiet about...
Anyway, it looks like Frank managed to convince his brothers. They got their stuff together and took a boat out to the stone giants. They were going to walk to the northern coast from there. I can only assume they went to Frozen Frontier where our elder, Froddy the Fidget can be found.
They didn't leave that long ago, so you shouldn't have any trouble catching up to them. However, the boys left in such a rush that they forgot to take the postal owls with them to send us messages. We weren't able to prepare our surprise for them in time either.
You've probably noticed that we're interested in necromancy. We think that's pretty normal in an area that's swarming with the undead. Christine and I had a little chat and the four of us came up with a plan.
Owls are fast and powerful birds but they're not invincible. On the other hand, those who are already dead have a harder time dying again. That means that owl ghosts are a lot better than regular owls.
Christine gave us a special amulet to capture their ghosts. It's called the Soulsucker. This means you've got some owl hunting to do. Once they're dead, use the amulet on the ghosts that appear. Do this to capture three ghosts for us.
So, any success? Is the Soulsucker working?
Have you captured any ghosts? Great! A ghost won't fall prey to hawks or hunters! Who knows, maybe ghosts will replace regular postal owls in the future!
Kill 4 Mercenary Vandals or Mercenary Wizards. Report back to Yefim Molotov in Gravestein.

Holy... That's one strange letter... I'll be damned! It's an order to have you killed!
Hey, calm down! I'm not doing it! I can't... Calm down! Just listen.
You see, our family has been connected to the rebels for a while now. Believe me, it's not because we wanted to. Those bastards are holding Andrey, our youngest brother, hostage. We're forced to supply them with a constant stream of money and food. Your exploits in Lightwood must have really annoyed them. So they ordered me to kill you. Hmm...
It's time to put an end to this servitude!
We only have one option - to strike first and then sink or swim!
The mercenaries have set up camp north of Gravestein. They are here to keep an eye on me. Go to their camp and kill four mercenaries.
We'll look for Andrey afterwards. You're our only hope now, remember that - all of Siveria is depending on you!
We have no other choice. We need to catch the mercenaries unaware, so don't waste any time.

They're dead? I wish I could have twisted their necks with my own hands. Too bad Andrey wasn't in the camp, but I wasn't counting on such luck.
But we still need to find him as soon as possible. We can't go to the defenders, that will only stir up rumors and the rebels have ears everywhere. And then our Andrey will be doomed.
Take 4 Tiger Heads to the Orcish shaman, Thunderfoot, in the Wild Orcs' Camp.

Discovering Ermolai's fate is our sacred duty. Since the Bear Tribe Orc was wearing his helm, we can be sure that the Orcs are involved. There's a clan of Orcs that lives near the stone giants. The Tiger Clan and Ermolai were mortal enemies until one day when he went alone to their camp. Ermolai performed their ritual, faced them in combat on the sacred path and climbed to the top of the stone giants to speak to their chief. And after that, the Orcs became noticeably less hostile.
But now they've got a new chief - a Bear Tribe Orc. I'm sure he knows something, but he won't be easy to reach. You'll have to repeat Ermolai's feat.
In order to challenge him, you must take four tiger heads to the shamans in their camp. It's at the far end of Frore Foothills. The tiger is this clan's totem animal and by making such a sacrifice you will prove your worth. Yes, I know, these dumb creatures only understand the language of force. That was the only way Ermolai could start a conversation with them. Only by challenging the Orcs will you be able to get to their new chief.
what the heck are you doing in our camp?! Answer me!
Now you're going to pay for your deeds. The tiger is our clan's sacred animal! Whoever kills it will pay in blood!
Climb to the top of the stone giant to talk to the chief, Talon.

You have the nerve to challenge our clan?! Not even an Orc is worthy of climbing up our scared path and only one stranger proved himself capable of doing it. I never thought I'd ever see anything like that again!
But the law is the law! You must climb the path all the way to the top of the stone giant and speak with our chief. And each guardian of the path, each and every one of them will want nothing more than to throw you off the cliff! And you better pray to all your gods to grant you a swift death, because if you fall, you will fall into in my hands and then the death of each tiger will be paid for by one hundred fold with wounds on your scrawny body!

Get out of here while you're still alive! I, Talon, did not capture the power in this clan just so I could talk to every little bug that manages to climb up here!
Run, you pitiful little gnat! Run, before I dump you into Vertush!
Defeat Talon, retrieve Ermolai's sword and report to the elders of Gravestein.

Ermolai was the first human to climb this peak, offering peace to the Orcs. He is a friend to the Tiger Clan, but we hadn't heard anything more about him until Talon showed up.
He said that Ermolai had been killed and that now all humans have to die and that the Gibberlings and Elves had to go with them. He defeated our chief, so we had to obey him. It's true that he's an Orc, but he is also an alien who doesn't respect our laws.
You can set things right again. You can defeat him, take Ermolai's sword from him and let us live according to our long established traditions. Your appearance at the peak is a sign that Ermolai's cause continues.
When you're victorious, return to your people and tell them that the tiger clan is true to their word.
Orcs, waterfolk, and the undead. With neighbors like those it's hard to feel safe.

So now we have Ermolai's sword - the Claw did not lie, this is his weapon. It's too bad that we didn't manage to learn anything more, but your courage saved us from a heap of trouble.
If that maniac the Claw remained at the head of the Tiger Clan, who knows what he might have come up with tomorrow! I hope their new chief will be more reasonable and benign. And as for you - please accept this weapon from me as a sign of gratitude.
Head north to the Siege Stronghold and speak with the Molotov Traders' Manager, Igor Molotov.

Here's what we have to do now - go to the Sieged Stronghold and find Igor Molotov, our manager. He is an experienced man and, most important, he knows everything about our problem with the rebels. Tell him that I sent you and he will help you find Andrey.
To reach the Stronghold, follow the riverbank past stone giants and keep going north, it's near the river bend.
It was built by Ermolai himself, by the way, so you might want to ask around while you're at it.
We lost everything in a single, great blaze. The amount of labor that was invested, the energy and time, now we have to start over from scratch!

So you were sent after Andrey? If the brothers decide to stand against the rebels then I'm on their side.
Except, I'm not sure how to help - you see, misfortune has struck our poor stronghold! First a forest fire started and our stronghold went up in flames like a tinderbox. Then the ogres showed up. I still don't understand how we survived!
Find the Eyepopping family and give them the Necromantic Cage full of messenger owl ghosts.

Now, go on.
Go catch our sons, give them this necromantic cage with the owl ghosts and tell them that their mothers love them!
Yes, you heard right, mothers! One may have given birth, but we brought them up together, so they're sons to all three of us. That's why everyone envies us Gibberlings. Humans, Orcs, and Elves only have one mother and one father while we've got three each!
Wait! Why don't we perform a little ritual before you go. There's no snow and the path is clear, that's a good sign that our ritual will work.
Hold the thread, don't let it go.
Chase your fate and do not fall.
Hold your ground but stray from the darkness. Keep that up and you'll be fine!
I thought I was going to die here all alone. Without even being able to send a message home...

Thank you for finding me! And these ghost owls will come in handy... Except it won't be good news that they'll have to deliver...
Don't try to help me, it's useless. I know a lot about wounds and I can tell that I'm going to die soon.
And that's good because my brothers, Asgerd and Sam, are already dead... I see no reason to live without them.
Kill 4 Icy Lynxes or Snowy Bears. Report back to the Arrow Family.

Who are you? Ah, it doesn't matter I suppose. The main thing is that you're not an Orc, bear, or lynx, so you can help. As you can see we've got a little bit of a yok here. What's a yok? Well, it's a bit like the end of the world, that's what we Gibberlings call it anyway.
When the stronghold burned down the forest creatures went mad due to the smoke. We tried to go into the forest but it felt like we were the prey rather than the hunters. We've got to deal with this problem immediately. Will you help us?
We need to put the poor beasts down. We can't have them running around the area and attacking everything in sight! I don't like it either, but sometimes you have to put on your big boy pants and do what needs to be done!
Siveria is a harsh land and surviving there is no mean feat, especially if you run into the crazy beast.
All is well that ends well. But please don't think us bloodthirsty - when you're hunting a predator it's always a choice between killing or being killed, and I rather like being alive.
Collect 4 Pages from Rightie's Book and bring them to the Cautious Family in Gravestein.

Oh, woe is us!
The Waterfolk attacked a raft carrying the Molotovs' goods the other day again. They stole the cargo and threw the rafters into the river... Bastards! And to make matters worse, our book was on that raft. Our dear friends from Lightwood sent it. Of all things! It made its way through the Astral, didn't get lost in Novograd, and then it ends up stolen here, in Siveria. It was such a good book on crafting tips written by Master Rightie. What a shame!
The Molotovka Traders managed to kill a Waterfolk that tried to approach Gravestein. And guess what he had on him?  A page from our book! Those savages tore it to shreds and split the pages among themselves. This is our chance to save it!
We're begging you! If you manage to kill one of the Waterfolk, please search them carefully. Some of them may still have a page. Or two.  If you bring us four pages of our book, we'll be very grateful! It would only be fair!
Oh, there were so many interesting stories in that book, like how Master Rightie tricked a troll! It was such a valuable book... Waaaaah...
Hurray! Our dear pages have returned! Thank you so much!
Participate in killing Kosmach and return to the Somber Family.

The Frore Foothills are a cursed place. Not only is it home to the fearsome tigers, but now a terrible yeti has appeared - Kosmach!
We're too frightened to even set foot in the place. We've heard tales about this Kosmach beast - they say that he's been asleep for many years and the commotion at the burial grounds woke him up. Now he's angry and hungry! Just look at us, we're practically bite sized! There's no way we can take him on!
This is where you come in. You'll need to gather a big hunting party and take him down. But please be careful, we'd hate to lose an able body such as yourself.
Every day it's something new... First, we get those terrible undead beasts and now a Gibberling-eating snow monster! What could be in store for tomorrow?
That's a relief to hear, but we can't let our guard down - who knows what's around the next corner!
How is the delivery of that letter going?
Participate in killing Ugluk, the hero of Bear Tribe and report back to Mila Ogonkova in the Sieged Stronghold.

The Bear Tribe settled here long ago when this land was wild and our attention was turned toward the coming war with the demons.
They lived here, knowing nothing of what was going on in the outside world. But now that the war is over and we're expanding and setting up trade routes, we're forced to deal with this problem. Don't they realize that this is our land?!
We must put an end to this - let them know that we were doing them a favor by letting them reside here, but now it's time to move on! Their tribe is weak but they have one ace in the hole, Ugluk, the hero of the Bear Tribe. He's a dangerous enemy - a symbol of power to his people, you must take him down first!
Not alone, of course. You'll have to gather a party right away. He'll be found outside of the Bear Tribe camp to the north.
The animosity between the Orcs and us is even more ancient than that with the Xadaganians.
So, Ugluk is dead... This is the beginning of the end.
Search around the deposit for any treasure.
Oh, ho! What do we have here? A mineral deposit? You should dig around and see if you found the mother lode!

Treasure!
Many thanks to the ancient Sarnaut denizen who buried the chest here!
Find the hidden treasure to the north and report your success to the Dashing Family.

Have you seen the giants? I'm sure you have, I'm talking about those two giant statues in the middle of Siveria - the ones with the horrible, ugly mugs. They say that they've been there since the time of the Zem civilization.
I heard that a treasure was buried not far from those giants. The legends say that they guard it with their stony gaze, but that's just rubbish!
We're dying to get our hands on that treasure, but it's far too scary to go there! But I'm sure you could do it, you look so strong!
Maybe one day we'll be able to find a buried treasure ourselves! That would be incredible!
You found the treasure? Hot diggity dog! I knew you could do it!
Kill 4 Savage Ogres in the caves. Report back to Mila Ogonkova at the Sieged Stronghold.

...In joining the ranks of the League Defenders, I solemnly swear to guard my country... to protect its interests on land and in the Astral... to be faithful to the ideals of the Light... to protect my brothers in arms...
Damnit all! My oath has been broken! Stop looking at me like that, Defenders cry too! If your friends were torn to shreds by ogres you'd be in the same state I am right now! I'm the only member of the stronghold garrison that survived...
Listen, you look like you've got weapons and know how to use them. Please go to the caves in Bone Valley where the ogres live and avenge my comrades. Avenge the fallen!
The ogres are celebrating their victory and are drunk with blood. You can catch them unaware, so do not delay!

An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth! May these murderers be damned along with those who gave them the idea to come kill us. The ogres are too stupid to plan such an attack. There must be someone else behind all of this!
Kill 4 Bear Tribe Firestarters. Report back to the Arrow Family.

Now we must dealing with those fire starters themselves. We know a raging fire like that couldn't have started on its own. The fire came from the south, just before the stone giants. We went there to investigate as soon as it died down.
And what do you think we saw there? A whole group of Bear Tribe Orcs - those bastards are the ones who set fire to the forest! The Orcs are still down there, probably planning some other atrocity. But we won't wait for them to act, right?
The Orcs couldn't have disappeared! Go back and look for them near the stone giants!

Those bastards got what they deserved! This is a dangerous place with all the Orcs, ogres, and wild beasts...
Much blood will have to be spilled before Siveria is truly ours!
Find 4 parts of a yak skeleton among the piles of bones in Bone Valley for Arthur de Delice at the stronghold.

This was a real bloodbath, believe me! The walls of the stronghold were literally melting in the fire, and when they fell, the ogres came... Ah, the dance of death, a frenzy of colors... mostly red... Oh, I'm sorry, I think I'm getting a little carried away here.
I, Alfred de Delice, a demonologist and historian, have come to these parts in order to investigate the Zem ruins. But now it is my duty to do everything I can to see that the horror I witnessed will never be repeated.
My necromancy will help me to create a guardian for the new stronghold - an undead yak! He will be a mighty and virtually immortal beast. All I need are dead yaks' bones. There are plenty of them across the river in the graveyard, where the yaks come to die.
Help me find the skeleton parts I need to create a guardian of Bone Valley and bring them back here.
I understand that digging around in those old bones is not the most pleasant of pastimes, but our safety depends on it!

This is it! Now, step back and let me show you how a real demonologist works!
Once, in my youth, I swore an oath to myself that I would only create beautiful things.
What a pity that I should break it now.
Collect 10 Refined Copper Blanks for Denis Molotov in Molotovka.

You there, you're a miner, right? Well, even if you're not, I'm sure you'll be able to find a way to get ore.
Listen, we hear talk about how booming the mining business up here is and we want in on it, but before we send our men out into the wilderness, we'll need some samples. That's where you come in.
I want you to go out and get me copper blanks. If they're good, we'll send our men out right away! Oh, and reward you, of course.
These are great! We'll be up to our eyeballs in gold in no time!
Use Igor Molotov's personal Guiding Shard to teleport to Novograd and deliver his urgent message to Lazar Polyankov. The message has to be delivered in 5 minutes.

Can't you see what happened? They burned our warehouse...
A heap of supplies is destroyed. All provisions we stored up for months to send to the capital.
We must report to Novograd immediately. They should immediately start looking for other sources of provision.
Will you help? This urgent message should be delivered to Lazar Polyankov, Overseer of the League Artisans very quickly. I'll give you my personal Guiding Shard. I bought it a long time ago in the Boutique. It will take you to Novograd in a moment.
What's wrong? Can I help you?

An urgent message from Siveria? Let's see...
Ah, a terrible news! It will be hard for us to deal with it.
Thank you for prompt delivery. I suppose you have used a Guiding Shard? Very convenient.
Convey the words of the Spirit of Freedom to Luchezar Popov.

Hear ye and spread the word for everyone standing up for freedom!
The curse didn't just strike the Valir castle, it struck the very Soul of Kania. And then she appeared - the one who has always thirsted for power. If not for herself, then for her son and if not over people, then over spirits. The vile hag tore apart the weakened Soul, splitting it into Good and Evil. She took the evil spirits for her servants and imprisoned the good ones. She locked me, the Spirit of Freedom, inside this idol. Where the other ones are, I do not know - the Spirits of Loyalty, Valor and Compassion.
The time has come to resurrect the Soul of Kania! To gather all the spirits! Kania cannot exist without loyalty, valor, compassion and freedom, just as it cannot be without cowardice, greed, and vengefulness. One flows into another and becomes its opposite, and back. Life is an eternal cycle. As Good cannot exist without Evil, so Evil cannot exist without Good.
Alas, I do not know the ways to resurrect the Soul of Kania. But I can name the one who does. The old witch's young stepdaughter saw her performing her evil deeds. The girl paid the price for her curiosity. The witch turned her into a toad. Find her and undo the spell. She'll help you. The Light will show you the way.
Now everything is as it should be. Thank the Light eternal! We are nearing the end.
One important question remains - where do we look for the enchanted toad?
Drink the Toadstool Infusion and defeat 4 Spectral Shadows using the Ecto Beam near the Valir Settlement. Report back to Foma Krytov.

There are ghosts in our settlement! You don't believe me?

No one believes me! I'm not mad. And I've seen them, I swear! I've seen them with my own eyes! See, the toadstool infusion keeps my third eye open. The whole settlement is crawling with those spectral shadows.

You know what? You should drink some. You'll see the ghosts, which means you can destroy them! What a good idea, huh? Don't you worry, I'll give you a weapon. Here you go. I inherited it from my father, along with the toadstool infusion recipe. He called this thing an egg... ec... Ecto Beam, and refused outright to tell me where he got it from. He only said it'd prove handy. Especially together with the infusion. I guess the time has come!

Four spectral shadows should do it. And don't forget to drink it before the hunt!
I could use the Ecto Beam, pour myself some good old liquor... Put up a hunt... A real one! Only I'm too scared!

All right! Other people can see the shadows, too. And even fight them. I was right. Now we can clear the Settlement from them.
Come back if you want to hunt the ghosts again. I'll spare no expense for the good cause!
Find four “haunted stones," examine them, and report back to Maria Rosinova in the Settlement.

There are many mysteries left in Darkwater that we have yet to uncover! Forests, and swamps, and... and forests, and swamps!
Do you want to know our land better? I can help. All we need to find are haunted stones, which lie in the most beautiful places. There are four of them. Touch them, take in their energy, and then come back and tell me all about it! Thirst for knowledge deserves a good reward, right?
Where are they? Remember, I won't say it twice.
I want you to go find these stones in the Astral Bay, Rookmore, Werebear Grove, and the Fusty Bog.
Have you seen them yet? They're in the four corners of Darkwater!

Well? What did you think?
It's really strange, right? They even disappear after you've touched them!
Seek out Darkwater's most dangerous creatures and bring back 5 trophies to Maria Rosinova.

Learning more about Darkwater is impossible if here are eerie creatures like these!
We'll never be able to move forward and collect new and interesting knowledge if we're too scared of them. Please, rid our land of them! Be sure to bring me back five trophies - something that will show that you really defeated these beasts!
You can easily recognize these creatures by their names or by crown symbols above their heads. I'm sure you'll come across them one day or another. Good luck!
Have you conquered your fears yet?
Excellent! Now you won't hesitate the next time someone sends you into someplace that's dark and creepy!
Learn more about the rebels in Darkwater by killing 75 for Maria Rosinova in the Settlement.

There are nobles that had lost all their nobility, and are eager to return to the past, whatever it takes. They are now called rebels, and boy are they dangerous! Wild beasts bite because their nature tells them so. The rebels attack on intention, totally disregarding the value of life! This can't be good.
I'm sure you'll come across them one day or another. Send them to Purgatory! It will teach them a good lesson of compassion, kindness, and tolerance.
Do those rebels tremble at the sound of your name yet?

Thank you, this information is great!
Unfortunately, we still were unable to figure out why they blindly follow that man... Oh, well. Maybe next time.
Collect 6 Sap Samples from the stumps in Darkwater for the Anthropologist, Maria Rosinova, in the Settlement.

Do you know what sap is? You know why it is so valuable?
You see, the trees in Darkwater produce a very special kind of sap... The very sap that is used to make our mirra! Do you understand now how important it is?
Your best bet to finding the sap is to look for stumps that have already been cut down. The pines were used to build new astral ships. I was strongly against this decision, but nobody cared...
Bring me six samples of sap, will you? I will generously reward you.
The trees that create the sap can be found all throughout Darkwater! Just keep an eye out!

These are perfect!
Your hard work is serving a great cause, you know.
Complete all of Anthropologist Maria Rosinova's tasks.

If you can successfully complete all the assignments I give to you, I'll reward you with a special present! A treasure, no less.
I have a very secret strongbox with valuable treasures... You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
No, you can't have it for free. So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Darkwater! And then we can talk.

Oh, thank you!
So few have been so eager to help me in my research! Go ahead, take anything that you'd like!
Find David Duzhev at the guard post in Darkwater.

It’s good that you're here. I've got a very important job for you.

Remember the Kanian riot? It's those mutinous Kanian rebels again. Yes, we showed them whose boss in Oreshek, but a final victory has not yet been achieved. Our scouts report that the enemy is gathering forces - there are rumors of mutinies circulating through the taverns and letters calling for disobedience and slaughter of the invaders, Elves and Gibberlings, are doing the rounds. We've heard whispers about some sort of "heir to the Valir castle," who is planning to lead the mutineers and reinstate "purity and freedom" in Kania.
I need a good agent in Darkwater, a wooded area to the southeast of Lightwood. It's a wooded area to the southeast of Lightwood. The Valir castle, now called Castle Blight and belonging to an ancient noble family that ruled over Kania long ago, towers over Darkwater. You see the connection? Now, if you add to that the fact that the castle has been considered cursed for many years... Few people dare to enter and none return.
It's a risky business. It must be dealt with by my partner... That's you, by the way.
Take the East road between the Eastern Sawmill and Amberwood, then take a tunnel in the mountains. It'll take you to Darkwater. There's a Defenders guard post just on the other side of the pass. Find David Duzhev there and speak with him. Find out what's going on and then play it by ear. Go.

Isaev sent you?
It's about time that the folks in Novograd remembered about us poor things in Darkwater. And the lawlessness we suffer from! You would have thought there wouldn't be a problem, given how close we are to the capital, but it's like a whole different country out here.
Life is tough. Bandits roam the roads, ghosts have appeared in the forest... That cursed Valir Castle seems to grow darker everyday! That's a terrible place, believe you me. But people get used to everything. The Settlement is by the castle and people still live there, they must have just grown accustomed to the curse. You should go there. If there's a root to all the problems, you'll find it there for sure.
Find out what happened to the merchants' wagon train and report to Dobrinya Nikitov.

Since you're going to the Settlement anyway, why don't you do me a favor on your way?
A wagon train filled with goods from Novograd went by here recently. They were the typical bunch of snobs from the capital. Phew. You know, I may not be fond of them, but... there are bandits everywhere out here and the roads are far from safe. I don't even know if those merchants even made it to the settlement or if they're worm food right now.
Being killed by bandits is a terrible fate. I hate to say it, but I doubt that those merchants made it there. If that's the case, could you please inform Dobrinya Nikitov about it once you get there? Deal?
The wagon train from Novograd should have been here ages ago. I don't understand. Could Karchikov be on the loose again? Tensess help us!
The wagon train has been robbed? Oh, I wish that just once someone would bring us good news!
Go to Darkwater and meet with Ivan Gubarevsky.

Hm... I think it's high time I tell you all details of a very important enterprise.
The Great Ball! I'm sure everyone in the world heard about it. Can words convey all the grandeur, the span of the magnificent Great Ball of eight elven Houses! Seven, to be exact. Seven houses!
The House de Doucer broke the rules of the Great Game. In their desire for power they used... unacceptable methods and were punished for it.
The circumstances of their crime are currently being investigated, but not all of the de Doucer Elves had a hand in it. The darkness has spread deep into the house, possibly deep enough as to engulf an Elf as great as Stephane de Doucer!
Stephane is a wonderful sculptor. He produces statues using magic, his works are truly magnificent. You sometimes feel that the statue is about to come alive! What a talent.
Unfortunately, Stephane might be involved in his House's crimes. Moreover, he continues to practice... let's call it "forbidden magic". We need to see if there's any truth to his guilt.
Go to Darkwater. Stephane is working on a job for a Kanian noble named Ivan Gubarevsky. I'm sure that neither Gubarevsky nor Stephane will tell you their true goals until they trust you. Meet with Gubarevsky and offer him your services without arousing suspicion.
Is your task clear?
Hey, take your hat off when you approach me! Anyway, you say you're looking for work? Well, I might have a job for you, but the only question is - are you up to it?
Escort Peter Bocharov to the Valir Settlement and report to the Keen Family.

Tensess be praised, a living soul!

Do you see what has happened here? Some vicious bandits attacked and killed my party! I survived in part by a miracle. What kind of miracle? A fairly common one - I stepped into the woods to answer the call of nature. Then I saw the bandits! I turned tail and ran! I just barely managed to tie my belt...

Have pity, good man, don't leave me to die here! Allow me to accompany you to the village. I need to find some Gibberling merchants called the Keen Family and tell them about this disaster. They'll want to know that all of the goods in the wagons were stolen! Ugh...

We're getting more jobs every day. Nobody watches over the roads. Kanians throw suspicious glances at us and call us names behind our backs! And that's not the worst part.
We've had nothing but grief since we came to Darkwater! Can anyone tell us what happened to the wagons with our goods?! Huh?

The wagon train was robbed?! We knew it! All the omens pointed to it - the ravens crowed last night and our wine was knocked over... Damnit!
That idiot herald keeps singing praises the praises of the White Knight, saying that the merchants don't need to fear the bandits because he's gotten rid of them all. What a rotten liar!
Slay Kaah and report back to Veleslav Kapishev.

Another horrible beast has been created by the curse.
Kaah, a terrible hydra, has appeared at Arrowsong Crossing. It's not only the merchants that can't pass through there - even the Defenders avoid those parts. I tried to talk to Dobrinya, their commander, but to no avail. You're our only hope!
Don't you worry. I believe that you can do it, especially after all the exploits that the entire Settlement's been talking about! The people are starting to say that the hero of Kania has been reborn and they're talking about you, not the White Knight! Well, can you help us out?
A hydra is certainly not as bad as, say, a demon, but not by much!
My heart is at ease now that Kaah is gone and the way across the bridge is open. Thank you! Thank Kania!
Kill 4 Black Wolves near the Arrowsong Crossing. Return to Dobrinya Nikitov in Valir Settlement afterwards.

I'm worried about Darkwater. The White Knight is muddling things up the most in the north.

I have too few guards to look after everything. No wonder the wolves have appeared in such numbers near Arrowsong Crossing. Veleslav is probably happy about that, but I'm not! To me, people are a hundred times more important than any forest beast. So I'm giving you this task. Kill four black wolves.

If you manage to do it, come back to me for a reward.
The wolves used to only walk the backwoods paths, never poking their noses out of the thicket. And look what's happening now! They are attacking people right on the highway!
Great, now we have something to show Aidenus. That old man will be pleased. Here's your well-deserved reward. I hope, it fits.
Kill 4 Venomous Adders and report to the caravan driver near Arrowsong Crossing.

Now for the last mission. That silly clay-loving elf - you know, the one we've risked our lives for hundreds of times... well, he's sent me new orders. He's expecting some kind of statue! Hic... And people told me he scul... erm... sculpted it himself. They're just screwing with people's heads, I tell you. But that's beside the point.

The wagon that's carrying the statue is stuck in the woods. Near Arrowsong Crossing. Apparently they're scared of some snakes... Hic... What feeble merchants we have these days. Go there and save the wagon... Hic... If you want to impress that elf! Kill four Adders and clear the path!
We've been through many lands, but have never seen awful snakes like your adders!
The road's clear? That's good news! We were just about to turn back.
Meet Raoul de Doucer in Amalthia Woods.

Oh! What a misfortune! Father wants to see all three daughters-in-law personally! I'm counting on the Elf and on you. So it's time for you to meet him. Now, listen to me carefully.
I made an arrangement with Raoul de Doucer, the great Elven sculptor, a long time ago.  I once saw an ancient statue of otherworldly beauty in a book. I said that I wished to have a wife like that. This Elf just jumped up and said, "Sure, no problem!"  Isn't he wise? Don't look at me like that! Your face will stick that way. Yes, he promised to turn this statue into a girl for me - a living and rosy-cheeked young lady!
Everything that the Elf asked for is ready. Go into Amalthia Woods where Raoul lives and tell him "Ivan is in dire need of a girl. He wants to marry her and present her to his father."
As for the toad? Into the swamp with her! For the better.
And where is Andrey? He's on a binge? I'm curious, is there anything at all that Kanians are able to do well and on time? No, Kania has no future, this is just further proof.

Alright. Since Andrey isn't here, you're going to have to assist me.
Actually, I've heard about you. From my brother. He saw you in Siveria. I received a letter from him the other day. From prison.
We were all forced to hide out in the woods and in quiet corners. And it's all the de Desiraes' fault! They've accused us of having broken the rules of the Great Game. But who doesn't break them? Everybody does. But you know what they say - you're not a thief unless you get caught. Anyway, I don't meddle in politics. Art is my way. And now you have been presented with an unprecedented opportunity - to assist Stephane de Doucer himself!
Kill Chuden the Awakened and report to Ivan Gubarevsky.

We must first correct this mistake. We can't allow this Chuden to stomp around the woods and attack the Kanians. You have to agree with me, right? That means we're going to have to kill it.
Poor Ivan! It'll be such disappointing news that you'll have to deliver to him. Of course, there's no chance of me refunding the deposit - I've already spent a ton of time on this job! Tell him that falling in love with marble statues is a bad idea. There are so many beautiful girls around!
And don't worry about me. Things like this often happen in art - you try for one thing and get another. One has to take such things in stride. It was a pleasure to meet you!
That toad looks at me strangely sometimes. I imagine seeing tenderness and pain in her bulging eyes... but soon I'll be rid of her and finally have my ideal wife!

That's it!
My life is over! Forever! My brothers are with their dear wives, and I'm with a toad! Forever! Please, just leave me alone. Let me be!
Find and kill the unicorn hunter, Miroslav Lyutov, that is hiding out in the Settlement and speak with the druid afterwards.

You want to know what brought about the curse of the unicorns? It's not just about the Cursed Castle Blight!
Kanians themselves are to blame for everything! Even unicorns, the most beautiful of beasts, could not escape their disgusting greed. People have been ruthlessly hunting and killing unicorns. For what? So this natural wonder - their magical horns - could be exchanged for a despicable metal! Awash in blood, the unicorns cried for vengeance. And I, the Spirit of Vengeance, took the unicorn leader's body to complete my mission - revenge! Revenge!
But now that I have abandoned the body that contained me, I am free. You will have to finish what I started. You will find a unicorn killer at the Settlement. Completely devoid of courage, this despicable murderer and trader was too afraid to leave Darkwater after the bandits started ambushing travelers on the roads. A poor decision. You shall be the weapon of revenge.
Kill him. I will reward you well, I promise. At another time, in another place, and with a different face. You'll recognize me when the time comes.

Many wars will break out, many passions will surge, things will pass and abate. The Spirit of Vengeance will never give up.
There will always be a place for it in this world! It will always be a part of me, a part of Kania!

You're demanding a reward for the deed?! Oh, since the Spirit of Vengeance demands that I do so... So be it! Take this weapon as your reward. Slay my enemies with it! For Kania is not a girl. It's a warrior that can stand up and fight.
Find 3 Petrified Unicorn's Tears in the Enchanted Wood.

In return for all your services, I want tell you about the greatest treasure that's hidden in these woods. Unicorn tears!

No, no, I don't want you to drive the poor animals to tears. That's impossible anyway. They only shed tears of happiness - only when they weep with joy. And these days, there's not much to rejoice about in Darkwater. That makes the tears that the unicorns sprinkle the earth with all the more precious. And once they hit the ground, these tears congeal and solidify into glittering droplets. Try to collect at least three  unicorn tears for me in the Amalthia Wood.
To be honest, I've never seen a unicorn tear in my life. I hope it's not just a legend...
Oh! What a miracle! How precious! How much will that be in gold? Let me count...
Kill 4 Cursed Unicorns and rid them of the darkness by using Luchezar's Staff. Then report to Veleslav Kapishev in Valir Settlement.

It is with a heavy heart that I tell you the story of the unicorns.
At one time, people came here from all corners of the allod to marvel at the unicorns that inhabited Amalthia Wood. But alas, the rot from the curse did not pass them by. I don't know whether it was the Castle Blight curse or something else, but black, cursed unicorns started appearing in those woods.
There is no other way of cleansing the rot from them except by death... Yet even as we kill these once beautiful and now damned creatures, we must do it wisely and follow the laws of nature.
Take this, it's a staff from Luchezar, our priest. The staff is filled with the magic of the Light and it will rid a fallen creature of the rot. Your mission is to kill the cursed unicorns and use the staff on their bodies to cleanse them of the darkness. I believe that the cleansed souls of these unicorns will return to their bodies and they will be resurrected in their former glory, restoring the equilibrium that was once found in Amalthia Woods!

It's been so long since I was last in the Enchanted Wood! Since I delighted in the innocent games of the unicorns under the slanting rays of the sun! I will cure you, my dears, I will cure you for sure.
I'm starting to believe that we will be able to lift the curse off Darkwater! And it's all thanks to you.
Kill 4 Aviak Mages or 4 Aviak Warriors for Dobrinya Nikitov in Valir Settlement.

I guess things aren't so bad after all. Aidenus is pleased with us. Under my wise guidance, your efforts didn't go unnoticed. All we have to do is consolidate our success!

The Thousand Wings forest is located to the northeast. We didn't go there even at the best of times but now we avoid it like the plague... There is an unusual winged tribe living in the forest called the Aviaks. They respect strength and courage. Unfortunately, they sided with the White Knight and have become his loyal servants. The Knight is a cunning villain, that's for sure!

The time has come to show the Aviaks who really rules Darkwater and on whose side truth and strength are to be found. That is your mission.

Kill four Aviaks. That should give them food for thought!
I never could understand the Aviaks. They're willing to serve anyone who'll prove to them that he is right. They're more gullible than children! Truth is on our side!
Well done! Soon, I hope, the Aviaks will send a messenger to ask for a truce with us. Here is your reward!
Release 4 Postal Owls held prisoner by the Aviak tribe. Report to Efrosina Somova in Valir Settlement afterwards.

Ivan's been walking around with a scowl.  Any idea what's wrong? Well, actually, I don't care. Surprisingly, I have no time for rumors at the moment. My head is too full of other things.

My poor owls, the things they have to go through! They started disappearing again. I thought it was the crows again, but it's worse than that. My winged messengers are being intercepted by those disgusting Aviaks. I have no idea what their plans are and why they are tormenting my birds - they're of the feathered kind themselves, mind you! But my owls need to be set free. They have been imprisoned somewhere in the Thousand Wings forest.
You have wings behind your backs as well! Don't you have any compassion for your fellow feathered creatures, you disgusting Aviaks?!
And now my owls are back on the wind! Thanks!
Sneak into the Aviak camp in the Thousand Wings Forest and speak with the spirit they worship.

Now that we are able to communicate with spirits, it is time to spread the Light and drive away the darkness.
There are Aviaks living in the Thousand Wings. They have never been on good terms with us and immediately chose to side with the White Knight. And now, rumors have reached me that they have, supposedly, abandoned the Light altogether. The Aviaks started worshiping some kind of spirit - this must be a mighty spirit to have an entire tribe in its service! You will have to sneak into the lair of the flying creatures and try to talk to this spirit. It won't be easy - the Aviak camp is very well fortified and guarded. But this is the chance for us, for all of Darkwater! The spirit is most likely contained in an idol. Try talking to it - that could clarify things!

The Spirit of Freedom is finally free! Finally! No limits and no laws for me!
I knew you were my salvation even when we met for the first time in the Witches' Circle.

Thank you...

The only form of imprisonment that I will accept is to be part of the Soul of Kania! What? You've never heard of the Soul of Kania?!

What?.. You've never heard of the Soul of Kania?!
Take the Holy Water to Ivan Gubarevsky.

This is so true. The Good and Evil. One flows into another and becomes its opposite, and back.
Life is an eternal cycle. What is light without darkness? It's void.
Well, back to our toad. What did you just say? Ivan had the enchanted toad this whole time? He married her and didn't say a word to me?
Oh, Ivan! You stubborn fool Of course I would have seen a human soul in a swamp creature! I have the remedy for evil magic - holy water! Just sprinkle some on the enchanted creature and it will appear in its true form. Unfortunately, this will only be temporary. The spell can only be lifted by the one who applied it in the first place. But still, run along - deliver the good news to Ivan.
Poor guy! I can't imagine what he had to go through!

Huh? What are you saying? The toad is an enchanted maiden?
Hmm... I did feel uneasy at times. As if I wasn't alone when the toad was around... Give me the holy water, quick!
Oh, how my heart is beating! What a beautiful maiden!
Harvest 3 Nettle Scapes in Thousand Wings, weave 3 shirts, and put them on 3 Enchanted Aviaks. Report back to Ivan Gubarevsky.

Baba Yaga is a pitiless witch. She trapped me in the body of a toad. My dear brothers didn't have it any easier, either. One is already dead. His soul is held captive inside the body of an angry cyclops. He cannot be saved...
The other eleven were transformed into Aviaks and set to guard the imprisoned Soul of Kania. I beg of you, set them free!
The only way to do so is with the stinging nettles that grow in the wilds of Darkwater. Collect three stalks of the stinging nettles. Weave them into shirts, and place them on my dear brothers. One for each. That should break the spell. Oh no, don't give me this look. Save at least three! We'll save the rest later!
Hurry! My time is running out... Tell Ivan of your success and he'll tell me about it.
As for the Soul of Kania, the key to bringing it back together is hidden in a magic amulet that Baba Yaga carries with her at all times. Tell Luchezar everything that I have told you, word for word!
What should I tell Vasilia? What has happened to her brothers?

They're saved! Thank the Light!
Hm, that means I now have three brothers-in-law... And I need to save eight more? That's crazy!
Find out where Baba Yaga has imprisoned the Soul of Kania and liberate it.

So, the magic amulet... The time has come.
Baba Yaga is hiding in Rookmore. The roads out there are well guarded by Aviaks and the White Knight's forces, so getting to her isn't going to be easy.
But what's going to be harder is forcing her to give up the amulet. I don't know where she keeps it but you need to find it, break it, and free the Soul of Kania, allowing all the spirits to be reunited!
That could be the root of all the troubles that have ravaged our country... It is being torn to pieces by old and new forces, while enemies from outside continue to threaten it! All of this is caused by the fact that the Soul of Kania is shattered...
Go now and may the Light and darkness show you the way!
I wouldn't want to be accused of blasphemy again...
I am free and whole! Kania is free!
Kill Baba Yaga and return to Ivan Gubarevsky.

Shall we chat?
Listen... I like Vasilia very much...  I hope she doesn't find me unattractive.
I never imagined that I would find my destiny in a swamp! I guess it's true what people say -"you win some and you lose some."
And boy, did I ever win! But now I am so afraid that I'm going to lose again! This Baba Yaga is still standing between us. As long as she's alive, her curse will hang over Vasilia. Please complete one last task and destroy the old witch. I will pay any price. I'll empty all my chests and give you the best of what I have!
If Baba Yaga survives and manages to evade her punishment, Vasilia and I will never be happy!
I wish I had something better to give you for all that you've done, but at the very least take this. And along with that, accept my boundless and eternal gratitude!
Kill 4 Kanian Rebels and the White Knight. Report back to Dobrinya Nikitov for the reward.

It's time to carry out Aidenus' orders and end this Kanian mutiny!
Luchezar and Veleslav told me everything that they've managed to find out thanks to you. And so, the White Knight, Miroslav Kramolsky, is the son of Baba Yaga, and, as she asserts, of the last Valir Count. Oh well, I'm not interested in his family history - the verdict has already been made!
You'll find him in Rookmore, the ancient forest. He'll no doubt have a bunch of Kanian rebels with him. Kill them all! If you prove yourself through this, you will receive a worthy reward from our entire Settlement.

Soon Darkwater will bounce back, free from the White Knight!
I just don't know how long it will take us to recover from his acts of charity.

It is done! The salvation of Darkwater is your achievement!
Your name will be preserved in the annals of our land! I am certain that the world will hear about you yet again. And this weapon will serve you well.
Convey the words of the Soul of Kania to Luchezar Popov, the priest in the Settlement.

I am free again... I am whole again... But I am still so weak...
The Curse of Castle Blight is what allowed the witch to enslave me. The events that took place in the Castle have been veiled by Death itself... I do not know what brought about the Curse! But what I do know is that while the Curse endures, I am weak and defenseless. We must find out what happened there and do something about it!
Your destiny is to finish what has already begun! Go back to Luchezar. That faithless priest, that failed demonologist, is best suited to help you. And just like me, he is stuck halfway between the old pagan Kania and the new Kania ruled by the Church of Light.
Talk to him!
Did you do it? Did you save my country?!

How do you find a woman's strength? What did she say? "...stuck halfway between the old pagan Kania and the new Kania ruled by the Church of Light..."
That's very true! I feel that duality within me. Light and darkness are struggling inside, as the old and new compete in Kania itself! I wonder if we will be able to reconcile them both...
Deliver Veleslav's letter to Kotofei in Lukomorie.

I need you to take this urgent letter to Kotofei, the Keeper of the Great Tree. I can feel the sun finally breaking through the clouds of the curse. It is almost time. Darkwater will be ours again soon!
Purr... What do you want from me?

Grr! I've been waiting for you... And the Great Tree has as well. I hear the blood in its limbs awakening, I hear it in the rustling leaves and in the songs of birds. Darkwater is awakening from its somber dream! Grr!
But it is still too early! The Tree needs time...Arm yourself with patience and wait. When the hour comes, I will find a way to contact you, grr. But you must stay vigilant as well! Always be ready for new tests!
Kill 4 Vandals and Oleg Melnikov. Report to Dobrinya Nikitov afterwards.

Oh, you've come just in time! We're short on hands. In fact, we're short on swords, axes, bows, and staves as well.

There's been a group of bandits hanging around these parts for some time... We've become used to them already and, quite honestly, they weren't causing too much grief. Yes, they did some robbing, but within reason. And they never murdered anyone. Then this "liberator" showed up. That blasted White Knight. He fought with our bandits. Chased them into the swamp, and even hung a few. That's when everything was set into motion. A new group of bandits took over the highway almost instantly, ones that I'd never seen in these parts before. They have no mercy for anyone. They rob wagon trains, kill the merchants after torturing them, and then hang them from the trees. The murderers' boss is a desperate cutthroat named Oleg Melnikov. He's the most ruthless of them all. There's no living with them!

Can you help us? Kill four of those cruel bandits and, of course, their leader.
Everyone that's able to bear arms, speak combat spells, or curse join forces to the fight against the band of cruel bandits!
One less headache! Darkwater needs people like you - brave, daring, and always ready to help.
Collect 4 Sacks of Goods for the Keen Family in Valir Settlement.

Those cruel bandits are killing the merchants and dumping the goods in the bushes... Can you search around the woods and bring me back at least four of the stolen bags with my goods? I'll reward you handsomely. I give you my word as an honest Gibberling.

Go now. And we'll keep our fists balled up for you! Six fists! It's a Gibberling saying. It's like we're holding fortune by the tail and not letting go until things come to a happy resolution. Let's see if it works.
I must have it all, hundred percent! Or else, I'm ruined!

Ah, so the superstition is true after all! Here are the sacks with my goods... See, it wasn't for nothing that I kept my fists balled up for you!
If things continue in this vein and everyone is as brave and courageous as you, the settlement will blossom yet!
Scatter 4 measures of Crowbane around the Valir Highway, then report to Efrosina Somova.

Finally, someone from the outside! Go on - tell me what news is going around the other allods. We don't know a thing here! What are they wearing? Are short skirts or are leggings back in fashion?
We're in the boonies here! No news ever reaches us... Before, I used to be the first to know everything that was going on, but now... I'm lucky to hear news a month after it happens! It's all because of those stupid crows that roam the Valir Highway. They kill all our postal owls and don't let any messages get through.
You're in a hurry, I see... Well, if you don't have the time to chat with me, at least take this poison and scatter it around the woods. Don't worry - it won't hurt anything but those rotten crows. Once we poison them, perhaps our connection with the outside world will be restored.
They say that Agniya was seen in the haystack with Veleslav last night. But as for the rumors are going around the capital - I haven't the foggiest... We don't get any mail.

Thank you! Now the messages are just piling up! Need to send an owl someplace? No? Too bad! It would have been a pleasure.
Come back if you want to help me again. We have predators, and we have scavengers. Besides, Novograd news are always welcome here. I'll appreciate it if you help me with the crows again.
Kill 4 Poisonous Adders or 4 Poisonous Spiders, then report to Ivan Gubarevsky.

Oh, you're looking for the Elven master? Sure, I know someone like that. But I won't share my secrets to just anyone for free. If you come and serve me, then maybe one day I'll send you on an errand to see the Elf.
Take these reptiles for example - those detestable creatures. Ever since the curse was set on the castle, we have had no peace from the snakes and spiders. These nasty beasts crawl in from all sides, it's just dreadful.
I personally lost a servant maid - a snake crawled right into her trunk. The poor girl turned black and swelled up so badly that we couldn't fit her into a coffin. Who can live like this?! You feel sorry for the wench? Me too. Something needs to be done.
Here's my first errand - catch and destroy ten poisonous adders and ten poisonous spiders - they're crawling around all over the place.

And then this spider climbed into the neighbors' chicken coop, dragged the chickens off into the woods, wrapped them in its web and hung them from a tree... horrible! These awful creatures have to be destroyed.
Killing one of these slimy creatures is a kindness! Thank you on behalf of the entire Settlement.
Collect 2 Poisonous Spider Glands and 2 Poisonous Snake Glands for Veleslav Kapishev.

Since you're here, will you help me out? Well, not just me, but the entire Darkwater.

Thoughtful Mother Nature, in her infinite wisdom, has prepared an antidote for every poison. Take snakes and spiders, for example. Do you think they are useless? Then you're wrong! Their poison is an excellent antidote. If taken in small doses, one can build an immunity to it.

Find two poison glands from both spiders and snakes. But this is no simple task as I have no use for the glands from dead animals. You must find a way to remove the gland from the living creature. My druidic knife will be perfect for this purpose. Be careful, it's very sharp!

It won't be easy to get close to them, but... here. It's a special wand that paralyzes the victim for a time, created by elven craftsmen. Use it on a snake or spider weakened by battle and, while the enemy is paralyzed, you'll be able to remove the poisoned gland!

May the shade of the Great Tree shield you from all adversity and misfortune!
Snakes and spiders should not be eliminated. We need to learn to live side by side with them.

Just what we need! Give it here... Watch it! It's poison, got to be careful with it.
Hm... Yes... Now for the hardest part - somehow convincing the people to drink it...
Convince 3 Settlement Residents to take Veleslav Kapishev's medicine.

I have prepared an antidote. Now go around the settlement and give it to three different residents: Ivan Gubarevsky, Efrosina Somova, and Foma Krytov. They feel pretty nervous about snakes. Start with them.
Only... Uh... There's no need to tell them what it's made of. Alas, not everyone shares my trusting attitude toward nature. Explain to the people that it's a magical remedy for the bites. And it probably wouldn't be a bad idea to put on an important look and start muttering spells. Whatever nonsense comes into your head... I usually recite children's counting rhymes in such situations... You know that popular one... "I spy with my goblin eye..." I'm sure you know it.
And for you, I'll read a spell that actually works later on.  You'll need it.
And as soon as the people swallow my poisonous medicine, their troubles will be over. I hope.

Well, how did it go? The people didn't put up too much resistance? No? That's good.
Hold on... What ghosts? Ghosts were popping out of the people?! Now that is weird...
Hm, I hope it's not a side effect of my medicine.
Collect 2 Bat Talons and 2 Crab Hearts for Agniya Charova.

Hey, what are you staring at? Careful, you don't want to get burned! Don't you know it's dangerous to stare at a witch? Even if she's a beginner... Ask anyone, it's better to be friends with me! If you need to put a love spell or a curse on someone, remove a wreath of celibacy or put it back on, I do it all.
Why be an outcast for no good reason when you can make a pretty coin? I have big plans but I can't do it by myself. Will you help a young and beautiful witch?
I have come up with a magical experiment. I can't tell you the details. I can say that neither our priest nor the druid have even dreamed of such a feat!
For starters, I need a few witching ingredients - claws and hearts. Five cave bat talons and five sea crab hearts should do. You can find these creatures to the south. Try and find them for me, will you?
So, do you think you can you handle it or shall I look for someone more capable?
The crabs live close to the sea and the bats live in a cave to the southwest. So, did you gather what I need?
We're in business! Just think of the gold you will make by helping me. But, shhh, mum's the word! The Settlement doesn't need to know about our business.
Gather Tender Boar Meat in the traps to lure out Zeeb.

The White Knight, the great champion and protector of Kania, the benefactor of the people who has done so much good, he who chased the formidable band of bandits from the woods, promises to keep all the good citizens of Kania under the protection of his high and mighty hand!
But now the White Knight is appealing for the help of all the good warriors, mages, and scouts... All who hold their native Kania dear! A huge beast has appeared in Lupinwood with fangs, the likes of which have never been seen before. The great gray wolf! This beast is full of ferocity and poses a dire threat to the entire Settlement. Just recently one lad and two villagers fell victim to the monster!
Whoever finds the courage and the valor within themselves to go against the ferocious wolverine, let them set the traps that have been placed in the woods, bait it with a piece of boar meat, and overcome the cursed beast!
Just remember that catching the beast will not be easy! He has been hunted many times but has always managed to get away. He who seeks to defeat the wolverine shall require both strength and fortune to come out on top!
Is the bloody beast dead yet?

What?.. The bloodthirsty wolf that the White Knight's herald has been shouting of, speaks in kind and intelligent words? Great are your doings, oh eternal Light!

To save the soul... Hm... But what soul are we talking about? Yours? I can see right through you, your soul is pure and nothing threatens it. What could this mean? Report to me if anything unusual happens to you on your journey. Saving souls is my job, after all.
Kill 4 Muddy Boars on the southern bank of the Raspberry River for Veleslav Kapishev.

I turn to you with a heavy heart. The curse and darkness have not only enshrouded the Castle Blight, but also led the forest beasts off their true path. The boars in Lupinwood seem to have gone mad and in an insatiable rage they attack trees, ripping off the bark and digging up the roots...

I've given this much thought. And this is what must be done. The true path is balance and symmetry with all that exists. The trees cannot stand up for themselves - therefore it is our duty to protect them. Be the hand of justice and kill four of the boars that have sinned against Mother Nature. We shall reward you greatly for this.
Boars tearing trees to pieces? Such a thing has never happened before. Something is wrong in the Kanian nation, mark my words, something is wrong!
Great Mother Nature will not forget your service. And from me, please accept this.
Find Andrey Vodopyanov in the Settlement.

It looks like you can be trusted with more important matters!
So, Have you seen my craftsman, Andrey, in or around the village?
He vanished recently, and there's been no sign of him. It's been nothing but trouble with these Kanian craftsmen! They start out with such capable hands, but as soon as he has a tiny amount of money, it's off to the tavern. Meanwhile, I'm left alone to do his job! It's a very important job that he was supposed to have finished a long time ago.
Find him and see what he is doing. And find out how that job is progressing.
Hic... An honest craftsman can't have any peace even in a tavern!
Hic... An honest craftsman can't have any peace even in a tavern! Alright, yes, I'm Andrey. What do you want?
Collect 3 fragments of Astral Amber for Andrey Vodopyanov in Valir Settlement.

Ah... So, Ivan sent you.
That Ivan is running me ragged! He makes me drag myself right into the very thicket to see that pointy-eared brat. I mean, that elf that makes dummies. The scu-sculptor... Hic... And these are such terrible times! Robbers are robbing and the beasts... have gone totally beastly. So... let us stick together...
Hic... I'll just sit here and finish my drink, and you can run over to the edge of the allod for the Astral amber in the meantime. This elf needs three. Hic... It's right where the sea and the Astral come together... Where the waves of the sea rise against the Astral waves - gorgeous! You won't regret it! And then come right back to me.
Go on!
Hic... I'm tellin' ya... one of these days the walls of the Castle Blight will bury us all... And nobody gives a hoot, they just want the Astral amber, don't you know! Hic...
Look at that, wow... It really is Astral amber. Hic... I never imagined that you'd be back so fast. It seems like I only had time for one drink... Hic...
Find the spirit on the coast in Lupinwood and speak with it using the Ghost Whisperer's Scroll and report to Luchezar Popov.

What were you talking to that pagan about? Ghosts? That's some guy you found to talk to about that! What do druids know about spirits?! You should've asked me. Here's what I would have told you if you had the right mind to ask.

There are two types of ghosts and both are well known to the merciful Church.

We call it a ghost when a mage calls up a soul from the ether and commands it. That is necromancy. But we call it a spirit when the soul of one who was slain through violence hovers over the earth seeking vengeance and, perhaps, solace as well.

But ghosts popping out of living people... That's something that has never been seen before.

They say that some kind of spirit has started to appearing near Lupinwood down by the sea. What if it's one of those that popped out of a living human as well? If only we could talk to it... Go find it, this scroll will help you to communicate with it.
Spirits, specters, ghosts... It's all such a tangled mess...
So you managed to talk to the spirit? Well, go on, tell me what happened.
Find the chest full of gold in the sea and take it to Evdokia Ogryzkova.

Huh! What? Who are you? Were you sent by my poor dear Evdokia? No?! Who then?
The priest? He wants to study me? Ohohoho...
Alright then, listen! Once, I cast my net into the sea and it came back with... Yes... With a golden fish! How happy I was to be able to bring my dear old lady some joy! The fish gave us wonderful gifts - a new wash tub, a new bed, and even a new house! We could have lived in such happiness. But then it was like an evil spirit possessed my dearest Evdokia. She started making more and more demands - a mansion in the capital, fierce Xadaganian guards on the front porch, bundles and bundles of new clothes and riches... The fish's patience snapped and she took everything from us and there we were, back with the old cracked washtub. My Evdokia completely lost her mind and then she cursed me - her faithful old man - she cursed me and... Killed me.
But I know, I've always felt it - there's an evil spirit controlling her! It needs to be fed, to be satiated, and only then will it disappear. Sea foam and storm winds have whispered to me that not far from the shore an old ship rests on the bottom and inside is a chest full of gold. Please find it and bring it to my Evdokia in our hut.
Ohhh! Gold! Gold! How it glitters and beckons... Give me the gold! Give it to me!

Huh! What happened? Where am I? Where is Esau? What, what happened here? Did he drown? No? ...I what? I killed him?!
It can't be! Oh, no! Oh, woe is me! Oh, Esau!
